Facts: The defendant 康某 is a medical staff at Chengdu city hospital. He used his position to illegally receive kickbacks (回扣) from a medical device company, amount 68,000 RMB. This is a classic case of bribery (受贿) by a public servant (medical staff is a state employee). The list includes "受贿" and also "单位受贿" (maybe for unit). The examples: earlier case with a medical staff receiving bribes was labeled "受贿". For example, earlier example: "韩某某在担任西宁某物业管理有限公司副总经理期间...非法收受闫某的行贿款200,000元人民币。" The answer was "非国家工作人员受贿". Wait that case: the person is not a state employee, so "非国家工作人员受贿". In our case, the person is a medical staff at a public hospital, i.e., a state employee. So the appropriate label is "受贿". Also there is "利用职务上的便利，非法收取他人财物，为他人谋取利益" which matches "受贿". The list also includes "利用影响力受贿" but that's a different label. The correct is "受贿". Also there is "单位受贿" which is for a unit (organization) receiving bribes, not an individual. So we choose "受贿". No other crimes.

Thus final answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>
